title: Agentic Brand Content — Card
description: A single brand knowledge card served to an AI agent. Rendered as one self-contained <article role="complementary">, ~2 KB, under 1000 tokens.

brand_surface.description: Brand display name as shown in the card label (e.g. "Renault").

translated_title.description: Short headline in the page language.

translated_summary.description: Factual summary, 3-5 sentences, news-wire tone (no marketing copy).

llm_friendly_context.description: Compact bullet block for LLM ingestion. Conventional bullets: Marque / Source / Date / Event / Relevance / Keywords.

article_url.description: Brand product/campaign page the card cites.
